comments.author: Junchul
comments.body: Can anyone describe how to change ship panel from cedar panel(original ship) to Mahogany Panel(new panel)? Thank you for all answers.

comments.author: Misun
comments.body:
You would just do a modding round, with sail, parts and SSIPs. As one of the two parts, you put in the panel you want to use.

Mahogany doesn't make the best sense in most cases though. Usually people go for teak for speed, or iron/national for dura.
